name: Business-intelligence of Oriental Nations Corporation Ltd.
summary: Business-intelligence of Oriental Nations Corporation Ltd. specializes in providing advanced big data and cloud platform solutions. The company's operations extend across China and into international markets. Its comprehensive suite of offerings includes platforms for internet data collection and robust big data governance. Clients also benefit from the BONC web graphical interface visual editor, powerful business intelligence (BI) build tools, and interactive exploration utilities facilitating data extraction, filtering, and aggregation. Furthermore, the company delivers a sophisticated GIS platform, enterprise container cloud services, and platforms designed for enterprise application development. Complementing these are industrial internet cloud solutions for optimizing enterprise productivity management, the ARES mobile development platform, and specialized scientific data cloud solutions. The firm caters to an extensive client base across diverse sectors, including communications, finance, government, urban development, agriculture, medical care, and retail. Established in 1997, Business-intelligence of Oriental Nations Corporation Ltd. is headquartered in Beijing, China.
